implementation: Local WebGL renderer; standard real EyeOpen/Breath parameters driven by unmodified CubismEyeBlink/CubismBreath at up to 30fps; cached pause/motion preferences and reduced-motion handling; no model motion/expression/physics/audio playback; optional pose initialized once at dt=0
maskMode: Official useHighPrecisionMask(true); redraw per drawable so blink-induced clipping changes do not hide unrelated parts.
